assigned_inputs.description: Pressure, lifetime-window classification, shedding and acceptor lists, and cutoff scope are preserved assignments. Their specification is not a derivation from the Axiom or empirical calibration.

isotope_parameterization.formula: at fixed Z, Delta support_sum = 68 Delta A; placement depends only on Z
isotope_parameterization.limitations: An A>=Z parameter value is a model operand, not evidence that the corresponding isotope exists or is stable.

reference_a.description: Preserve the exact supplied A for each of the 118 element references. The prior generator called these reference mass numbers but provided no per-row catalog citation, selection algorithm, uncertainty or stability claim. No most-abundant, standard-weight, stable-isotope or observed-isotope policy is asserted here.

unfilled_a.description: A=round(2.55Z), Z=119..126, preserved from the pinned generator. These are unfilled reference positions; their operands are not an observed isotope catalog.
